fit_resources.scope: Full tuning fit process from pre-import through export, includes nested fit-card stages; do not add both

limitations: Screening omitted short/long budget outcomes; no global or every-model saturation claim.
B5 improvement is smaller than previously observed timing displacement; no confirmed effect.
B3/B4-L1 share one identical logical policy/asset and physical outcome set.
Seed17 and reused assets are conditional-on-fit evidence; no independent original or fit population added.

expansion.rule: Only the best B3, best B4 and best B5 deployments: if improvement over same-stage ridge1 original baseline >=.0002 and full cold sum ratio<=1.25 and measured median inference<=5ms, extend a winning alpha.1/10 boundary once to.01/100, or winning hist7 once tohist15. Reuse B5 assets when identical. Deduplicate L1. Other fixed regimes are bounded joint-search screening, not globally saturated.

protocol.reason: Review I1: fresh B3/B4/B5 actual-regime tuning lacked stopping evidence
protocol.resource_stop: One actual-regime nonlinear rung and two regularization neighbors per regime, hierarchical survivor allocation, at mostone conditional outward step for each winning control. Further tuning stops at this finite resource allocation; report any continuing trend, do not call it statistical/global convergence.
protocol.reuse: alpha1 exact-regime assets; B5 matched6564-row hist7/15/31 assets deployed with control_id=B5; no duplicate fits
protocol.scope: Public exploratory conditional-on-fit tuning; six originals remain six; preserve all previous1614 attempts/cards; no protected outcomes

screen.purpose: Resource screening only; omitted candidates have unmeasured short/long-budget advantages, flagged explicitly

protocol.selection: Completed three-budget weighted utility, ties lower total cold request wall then model bytes/name; no seed aliases or screen score used as final score.
protocol.source_freeze: No runtime changes, fitting or tests during timed stages
protocol.survivors: Winner per fixed regime; L1 runner-up; highest remaining fixed contender; top2 B5; original L1/B5 ridge1; B0/no-plunge/estimate-L1. At most16 methods; exact count/config sealed after screening, before timing.
